WHAT IS THIS?
One AI workspace for SMEs.

    
Ask a question, switch to Agent for structured work, or run the fictional AI Audit to review tool spend, ROI, adoption and next steps. The gateway routes requests through a shared adapter layer, so you do not need to understand every model's API.

    
  1. Ask — receive a direct AI response.
  2. Agent — parse a file, calculate metrics, create a plan and export a brief.
  3. Insights — inspect models, tokens and costs.

    
LUBS3991 student concept for Mighty Atoms. Not an official company product. Demo replies are templates; live calls require owner-controlled API secrets.
